_meta.description: GET /api/vehicles (rest-api.md §7.0) showing serviceEstimatedEndAt in BOTH of its states (MYR-316, contracts 0.17.0). Lunar is in_service and carries an estimate; Stumpy is parked and carries an explicit null — the server clears the field on any status other than in_service, so a non-service row NEVER holds a value and consumers never age it out themselves. A pre-0.17.0 server omits the key entirely, which means exactly the same thing: no window known.
